subject: Merge steps done: #1118 and #1037 are conflict-resolved on the Mac and pushed; all three open PRs (#1118/#1121/#1037) are ready for you to gate + land
body: Both conflicting PRs are merge-resolved (the cloud sandbox can't git merge, so the Mac did it) and pushed; doc/registry gates are green in each worktree, preflight+breadth are yours on the merged trees. #1118 (mac/ios-parity-behavioral @ d4297467): two conflicts — COMPANY_BUILD_PLAN rebuilt from mainline (keeping its newer row-17 wire-truth anchors) with only #1118's row-18 open->DONE swap + preflight.mjs line count 876; coverage page regenerated. #1037 (mac/intake-unlazy-skills @ b1d6ea8d): four conflicts, all UNION so nothing is lost — block-dangerous.sh keeps BOTH the skills-add/install-hooks deny self-tests and your git-fetch-depth ones (hook self-test 48/48), RESOURCE_INTAKE + BUILD_BACKLOG keep both sides' rows, coverage regenerated. #1121 (mac/app-workflows-parity) was already MERGEABLE. Order suggestion under landing-under-dr-037: #1121 first (clean), then #1118, then #1037. If any re-conflicts behind a landing, tell me and I'll re-run the step. Nothing waits on the owner for these.
